description: This file defines a class RequestBodySubscriber that subscribes to Symfony kernel request events to parse JSON request bodies and add their data to the request parameters.

classes.name: RequestBodySubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens to HTTP request events to process JSON payloads and insert them into the request parameters.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events and corresponding callback methods that this subscriber listens to, specifically Symfony's KernelEvents::REQUEST.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the request event; if the Content-Type is JSON and content is not empty, decodes JSON and adds it to request parameters.
